requirement.title: Create new tmux session with agent
requirement.description: Ctrl-N or :new enters a session creation flow: user provides a project directory path (fzf-style picker starting from ~, with text input), session name is auto-suggested from the directory name, and user can edit the launch command (pre-filled with "claude -c").

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given user presses Ctrl-N, when the creation flow starts, then a directory picker appears rooted at ~ with text input filtering.
Given user selects directory ~/GitHub/AI/myproject, when the session name prompt appears, then it is pre-filled with "myproject" (derived from directory basename).
Given user confirms directory and session name, when the launch command prompt appears, then it shows a pre-filled editable input with "claude -c".

Given user confirms all inputs (dir=/path, name=myproject, cmd="claude -c"), when Commander executes, then: tmux new-session -d -s myproject -c /path is invoked, followed by: tmux send-keys -t myproject "claude -c" Enter.
Given the session name already exists in tmux, when Commander attempts to create it, then an error message is shown: "Session 'myproject' already exists".
Given creation succeeds, when the next poll cycle runs, then the new agent pane appears in the session list.

requirement.title: Kill tmux session
requirement.description: Ctrl-K kills the selected tmux session. Since this is destructive (terminates the agent), a confirmation prompt is shown first.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given session arcforge:1.1 is selected and user presses Ctrl-K, when the confirmation prompt appears, then it shows "Kill session arcforge? (y/n)".
Given user confirms with y, when Commander executes, then tmux kill-session -t arcforge is invoked.
Given user declines with n or Escape, when the prompt closes, then no action is taken.
Given the session is killed, when the next poll cycle runs, then the pane is removed from the session list and a "session ended" notification appears.
